capabilities: ebook-library | Stores e-books in a Calibre library and serves them through a web interface and an OPDS catalog; books dropped in the ingest folder or uploaded in the web interface are converted, imported and given their metadata.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official Calibre-Web-Automated image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Calibre-Web-Automated is a fork of Calibre-Web, a web app for an e-book library: it reads a Calibre library, lets you browse, search, read and download books, and serves an OPDS catalog for e-reader apps. This fork adds automatic ingest: a book uploaded in the web interface is converted if needed, given its metadata and cover, and added to the library. Your settings, users and the library are kept in the `calibre-web-automated` folder of your home, so they survive stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated administrator password. Sign in at `https://<instance>/` as `admin` with that password. Public registration and anonymous browsing are off. The instance has one large-file limit to know about: the platform stores files of up to 1 GiB, and a restore copies whole files, so a large library takes time to come back. You can run one instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream Calibre-Web-Automated wiki and issue tracker for software-specific help.

features: Browse, search, read in the browser and download e-books
Automatic ingest: uploaded books are converted, given metadata and covers, and added to the library
OPDS catalog for e-reader apps, and KOReader progress sync
Multiple users with their own shelves and permissions
Your library and settings are kept in your home, across stops, restarts and re-enrollment

CWA_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own. It is the password of the `admin` account only when the instance first creates its settings database; if your data already exists (an earlier enrollment, or a restart) this value is ignored and the existing password still applies. Change the password in the web interface. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.
